name: NVIDIA Low Latency Mode + Prefer maximum performance
description: Sets the global NVIDIA driver profile to Low Latency Mode = On (at most 1 pre-rendered frame) and Power management mode = Prefer maximum performance, through NVAPI - the same settings store the NVIDIA Control Panel writes. Low Latency Mode can reduce input lag when the GPU is the bottleneck; it does nothing (or costs a little throughput) in CPU-bound games. Prefer maximum performance keeps the GPU at higher clocks at the cost of idle power and heat. Takes effect for newly launched games, no reboot.
touches: NVIDIA driver profile store (nvdrsdb), base profile: PRERENDERLIMIT (0x007BA09E) via NVAPI
NVIDIA driver profile store (nvdrsdb), base profile: PREFERRED_PSTATE (0x1057EB71) via NVAPI
warning: Changes the GLOBAL driver profile, so it affects every 3D application. Prefer maximum performance raises idle power draw and heat - that matters on laptops. Low Latency Mode can slightly lower average FPS in CPU-bound games. Benchmark before and after; Revert restores your exact previous NVIDIA Control Panel values.
